name: 30513 · Blue Ridge, GA
findings: ZIP 30513 (Blue Ridge) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 8 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30513 (Blue Ridge) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
